test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Hardik's horoscope says / that the stars / will be exercised/ a benign influence on his life.

options.text: a benign influence on his life

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"will be exercised."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb **'exercised'** is not appropriate in this context.
 
• The word **"exercised" **means to make use of something, for example, a power, right, etc. ((सत्ता, अधिकार आदि का) इस्‍तेमाल करना)
 
 
• **Example:** *You should **exercise**__ your right to vote.*
 
 
 
• The correct verb should be **'exerted.'**
 
• **'Exerted' **means to apply or bring about. (किसी वस्‍तु को प्रयोग में लाना (जैसे प्रभाव, ताक़त आदि))
 __
 
• **Example:** *Parents **exert**__ a powerful influence on their children’s opinions.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

**Correct sentence:** *Hardik's horoscope says that the stars __**will exert**__ a benign influence on his life.*
